reviews.text: This rooftop bar has panoramic views, perfect for taking photos. Some customers say that the cocktails and golf drinks are good and the prices are reasonable. reviews.text: A landmark of Hongdae nightlife, this club has captivating African music rhythms, a lively atmosphere that will make you lose track of time, and cocktails that exceed your expectations. Reservations are a must as it is almost always packed on weekends. The price range of 20,000 to 30,000 won per person may be burdensome for students, but it is a good space for occasional special occasions. Staff are friendly, but drinks can be a bit late to serve during peak hours. The food menu is limited but the taste is good. If you like music and dancing, this is a must-visit place in Seoul, but if you want quiet conversation, you'll need to look elsewhere. Overall, the music and atmosphere are perfect, but even if the price/satisfaction is a bit low, it's still worth recommending. I've been here three times, and each time I go I find something new to enjoy. The DJ's quality is consistent, the dance floor is well designed and not too crowded. The only downside is that the line for the bathroom is long, so it's best to arrive early to get a good spot.

I tried Dalgona again after decades.

It was truly amazing to be able to experience so much K-culture in one place.

Rather than simply seeing or reading,

I was actually able to experience everything firsthand.

Make kimbap and eat delicious Hangang ramen,

reviews.text: I had a really great experience at K-Stying Lounge. You were really welcoming and kind. I was able to have a variety of cultural experiences, including making dalgona, dorigae, and kimbap, learning to write Korean, and reading tarot cards. It was such a fun time!

reviews.author: Patrick Rosel
reviews.text:
OAVO K-Style Lab is more than just a dining space. This is the perfect lounge to experience K-culture and K-beauty.

The food was great and the service was great! In particular, Chef Aaron's cooking was really great. The boneless traditional chicken and japchae were especially delicious.

Thanks to Manager Tony's attentive service, I was able to learn more about the various aspects of OAVO (restaurant, beauty product line, and even the traditional Hanbok experience on the second floor).

It was a fantastic experience combining taste, culture, and warm hospitality. OAVO Team, thank you so much!

Anyway, everything was not that good, so I left the tripe behind. My princesses were also very upset... and resented the person who had guided them to the opposite side from the restaurant we had originally gone to.
The few hours at the board cafe were so fun and smooth, and when you think of Hongdae, busking comes to mind.

reviews.text:
🔴 [Hongdae] ‘Red Road’, a street you want to walk on, a busking paradise where youth explodes!

I went to ‘RED ROAD’ leading from Exit 9 of Hongik University Station! This street, with its red floor, is truly a place where youthful energy explodes.

The once crowded streets have widened to make it easier to walk, and thanks to busking performances taking place here and there, your eyes and ears won't have time to rest. You can enjoy the passionate performances of professional artists, including dancing and singing, up close.

The route between shopping and restaurants is perfect! If you want to fully experience Hongdae culture, this is a must-visit course. Highly recommended when you want to recharge your energy! 👍

reviews.text: Hongdae Red Road is a popular tourist attraction and pedestrian street in Mapo-gu, Seoul. You can see many people walking their dogs here, and like a pet park, you can relax while watching the dogs run around.😆🐶 You can easily get there by getting off at Hongik University subway station.

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Hongdae Red Street is painted red from Hongik University Station Exit 9 to the end of the street and is a place full of youth and artistic vitality. Street performances take place continuously in the spacious and comfortable space, and the captivating shows of professional dancers and singers provide unforgettable memories. Shopping and dining options are plentiful, allowing you to truly experience Hongdae's cultural uniqueness. You can visit on both weekdays and weekends without waiting or making a reservation. We recommend visiting in the evening to enjoy the best atmosphere. It's a great place for young people to relax and recharge, but when it gets too crowded, its appeal can be somewhat diminished. Overall, it's a must-visit place in Seoul, but it feels a bit commercialized, so I hope it preserves its original, more artistic look in the future. Suitable for tourists who enjoy nightlife and street culture.

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Hongdae Pedestrian Street is a vibrant place you must visit in Seoul. There are many shops, restaurants, and cafes, so you can enjoy a variety of products and delicious food. On weekends it is crowded and has a lively atmosphere. Street performers provide an attractive attraction, while solo performances by male singers and traditional Korean dance performances add a special charm to shopping. From famous artists to ordinary performers, a variety of people come together to create a unique cultural landscape. It may be a bit crowded, but the lively atmosphere is definitely worth experiencing. We recommend visiting on a weekday to avoid the crowds. No reservations are necessary, and you can enjoy the vibrant energy of the city at any time. Hongdae Pedestrian Street is a great place to experience young Korean culture and enjoy shopping.
